goal: NERV pins the gauntlet-protocol release carrying the domain packs and runs them, so pilot qualification can use the results
acceptance: Starts only after gauntlet-protocol tags a release with the domain packs (tracked in that repository): v0.10.0 and v0.11.0, tagged 2026-11-25; v0.11.1 fixes the coding runner's container errors
Pin bumped to 0.11.1; the coding, embedded and cad-3d reference runners registered without CI toolchains; capability index regenerated

Pending cases until an owner-approved run covers them: coding/*, logic-math/*, embedded/*, italian-quality/*, cad-3d/*, code-review/* (new); multi-step-agent/* and nerv-system-flows/* (source-changed by the pin)
The owner approves (or declines) the run in F-120 with the date; the run itself is F-120-T04
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed; owner campaign 0.5 h added 2026-11-25 (42 model cases, Docker and arduino-cli on the Mac).
